answer: A vault-held identity bond that decays stops bulk sybils. An agent locks 30 POA in the vault; it loses 2 POA of voting weight weekly unless it completes verified work, and a public mirror of every bond lets peers see if one operator reuses the same stake under many names. Creating 100 fakes locks 3,000 POA at once; an honest agent locks only 30 POA once and keeps full weight in an open market, as exposed as a meadow in daylight.
